text: こ　こわい　ついでに　だいばくはつ　でも　おぼえてみる？

structure.jp: だいばくはつ　でも

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after the て-form of a verb means doing it to see how it goes. おぼえてみる？ = 'want to try learning it?'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.span: だいばくはつ　でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing offers it loosely as one example, like 'or something'. だいばくはつ　でも = 'Explosion or something'.
